LBL_cycleTime: Time between data polls from the charger [ms]
LBL_stateHomeSolarPower: Object ID for the currently available solar power [W]
LBL_stateHomeBatSoc: Object ID for the current state of charge of the home battery [%]
LBL_stateHomePowerConsumption: Object ID for the current home power consumption [W]
LBL_subtractSelfConsumption: Charger consumption is included in the home power consumption value
LBL_chargeManagerReservePower: Grid reserve power kept free instead of charging the car [W]
LBL_chargeManagerMaxBatteryBonus: Maximum battery bonus added to the surplus near 100% SoC [W]
LBL_readOnlyMode: Read-only mode - charging release is not sent to the charger (for use with RFID tags)
